name: 1/4" NPT to 3/8" Barb
title: 1/4" NPT to 3/8" Barb
description:
The 1/4" NPT to 3/8" Barb is engineered for high-demand automotive fluid systems. This Adapter is available in the following color: Purple

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with hard anodized protective finish.
• Thread Pitch: Precision NPT tapered threads for leak-free sealing in blocks and cells.
